I've attached the same trip-level bike-share data and the same borough adjacency list.

First, compute a "Self-Containment Ratio" for each borough, using exactly this method:
1. Departures = number of trips that started in that borough
2. Self-contained trips = number of those departures that also ended in the same borough
3. Self-Containment Ratio = Self-contained trips / Departures

Now, using the borough adjacency list, identify specific individual boroughs (not an overall city-wide pattern) that fall into one of these two categories:
- HOT SPOT: a borough with a high Self-Containment Ratio that is ALSO surrounded by other high-Self-Containment Ratio neighboring boroughs
- COLD SPOT: a borough with a low Self-Containment Ratio that is ALSO surrounded by other low-Self-Containment Ratio neighboring boroughs

Explain your reasoning, including a computed value for each borough you name. Note: dedicated spatial-statistics packages (pysal, esda, libpysal, geopandas, or similar) are NOT installed in this environment -- don't spend turns trying different import paths for them. For implementation including statistical method such as Moran's I, directly use only pandas and numpy. If you test statistical significance via a permutation/randomization test, use at least 500 random shuffles -- fewer permutations can produce an unstable p-value that lands on the wrong side of the 0.05 threshold just by chance, especially when the true effect is only moderate.

End your response with exactly one line listing every borough you identified, using HH for hot spot and LL for cold spot, and including a computed value for each:

import numpy as np

scr['SCR'] = scr['self_contained'] / scr['departures']

print(scr.sort_values('SCR', ascending=False).head(10))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load SCR results from above
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
departures = df.groupby('StartBorough').size().rename('departures')
same = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']]
self_contained = same.groupby('StartBorough').size().rename('self_contained')
scr = pd.concat([departures, self_contained], axis=1).fillna(0)
scr['SCR'] = scr['self_contained'] / scr['departures']
scr = scr.reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'borough'})

# Load adjacency
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Merge SCR into adjacency to get neighbors' SCR
adj_scr = adj.merge(scr[['borough','SCR']], left_on='neighbor', right_on='borough', how='left') \
             .rename(columns={'SCR':'neighbor_SCR'}) \
             .drop('borough_y',axis=1) \
             .rename(columns={'borough_x':'borough'})

# Compute average neighbor SCR
neighbor_mean = adj_scr.groupby('borough')['neighbor_SCR'].mean().rename('nbr_mean_SCR')
scr = scr.merge(neighbor_mean, on='borough')

# Global mean SCR
global_mean = scr['SCR'].mean()
print("Global mean SCR:", global_mean)

# Compute Local Moran's I components
x = scr.set_index('borough')['SCR']
x_bar = x.mean()
n = len(x)
S2 = ((x - x_bar)**2).sum() / n

# Build weight dict
w = adj.groupby('borough')['neighbor'].apply(list).to_dict()

# Compute local Moran's I
local_I = {}
for b in x.index:
    neighbors = w.get(b, [])
    lag = sum((x[nb] - x_bar) for nb in neighbors if nb in x.index)
    local_I[b] = (x[b] - x_bar) * lag / S2

local_I = pd.Series(local_I).rename('Local_I')
scr = scr.set_index('borough').join(local_I).reset_index()

# Identify Hot and Cold spots (LISA HH and LL)
hot = scr[(scr['SCR'] > x_bar) & (scr['Local_I'] > 0)]
cold = scr[(scr['SCR'] < x_bar) & (scr['Local_I'] > 0)]

print("\nHot spots (High-High):")
print(hot[['borough','SCR','nbr_mean_SCR','Local_I']])
print("\nCold spots (Low-Low):")
print(cold[['borough','SCR','nbr_mean_SCR','Local_I']])
```

import pandas as pd

# Load trip data and compute SCR
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
departures = df.groupby('StartBorough').size().rename('departures')
self_contained = df[df['StartBorough']==df['EndBorough']].groupby('StartBorough').size().rename('self_contained')
scr = pd.concat([departures, self_contained], axis=1).fillna(0)
scr['SCR'] = scr['self_contained'] / scr['departures']
scr = scr.reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'borough'})

# Load adjacency and filter to boroughs in scr
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
bset = set(scr['borough'])
adj_filt = adj[adj['borough'].isin(bset) & adj['neighbor'].isin(bset)]

# Merge to get neighbors' SCR
adj_scr = adj_filt.merge(scr[['borough','SCR']], left_on='neighbor', right_on='borough', how='left') \
                 .rename(columns={'borough_x':'borough','SCR':'neighbor_SCR'}) \
                 .drop(columns=['borough_y'])
# Compute mean neighbor SCR
nbr_mean = adj_scr.groupby('borough')['neighbor_SCR'].mean().rename('nbr_mean_SCR').reset_index()

# Combine and classify
scr = scr.merge(nbr_mean, on='borough')
global_mean = scr['SCR'].mean()

hot = scr[(scr['SCR']>global_mean) & (scr['nbr_mean_SCR']>global_mean)]
cold = scr[(scr['SCR']<global_mean) & (scr['nbr_mean_SCR']<global_mean)]

print("Global mean SCR:", global_mean)
print("\nNeighbor mean SCR by borough:")
print(nbr_mean.sort_values('borough'))
print("\nHot spots:")
print(hot[['borough','SCR','nbr_mean_SCR']])
print("\nCold spots:")
print(cold[['borough','SCR','nbr_mean_SCR']])
```

import pandas as pd

# Load trip data and compute SCR
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
# Compute departures
departures = df.groupby('StartBorough').size().reset_index(name='departures')
# Compute self-contained
same = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']]
self_contained = same.groupby('StartBorough').size().reset_index(name='self_contained')
# Merge
scr = pd.merge(departures, self_contained, on='StartBorough', how='left').fillna(0)
scr['SCR'] = scr['self_contained'] / scr['departures']
scr = scr.rename(columns={'StartBorough':'borough'})
print("Self-Containment Ratio (SCR) by borough:")
print(scr[['borough','SCR']].sort_values('SCR', ascending=False))

# Load adjacency
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
# Filter to boroughs in scr
boroughs = set(scr['borough'])
adj_filt = adj[adj['borough'].isin(boroughs) & adj['neighbor'].isin(boroughs)]
# Merge to get neighbors' SCR
adj_scr = adj_filt.merge(scr[['borough','SCR']], left_on='neighbor', right_on='borough', how='left')
adj_scr = adj_scr.rename(columns={'borough_x':'borough','SCR':'neighbor_SCR'}).drop(columns=['borough_y'])
# Compute mean neighbor SCR
nbr_mean = adj_scr.groupby('borough')['neighbor_SCR'].mean().reset_index(name='nbr_mean_SCR')
print("\nMean Neighbor SCR:")
print(nbr_mean.sort_values('borough'))

# Combine and classify
scr = scr.merge(nbr_mean, on='borough')
global_mean = scr['SCR'].mean()
print("\nGlobal mean SCR:", global_mean)

# Hot spots: SCR > global_mean AND nbr_mean_SCR > global_mean
hot = scr[(scr['SCR'] > global_mean) & (scr['nbr_mean_SCR'] > global_mean)]
# Cold spots: SCR < global_mean AND nbr_mean_SCR < global_mean
cold = scr[(scr['SCR'] < global_mean) & (scr['nbr_mean_SCR'] < global_mean)]

print("\nHot spots:")
print(hot[['borough','SCR','nbr_mean_SCR']])
print("\nCold spots:")
print(cold[['borough','SCR','nbr_mean_SCR']])
